rule_D.notes: D alone retires allowlisted untracked images per file in top-level QA/candidate runs whose ordinary images are ALL older than 30 days. Recent text/log/index mtimes do not rejuvenate old images; any recent ordinary image still vetoes the entire run. Financial/secret/state/database/.git files and protected sibling subtrees remain untouched without vetoing safe siblings. A sealed QA name alone is not a live pointer. Live-release/deploy-pointer policy entries and script/config consumers retain protection; narrative reports and copied report current*.json are not consumers. The operator decision supersedes the blanket QA protected_root ONLY for D; keep it for every other rule. Baselines/fixtures/tests/ws-v/scripts/quarantine remain outside run scope. Keep all non-image originals, content/roundtrip-verified compressed text copies, checksum MANIFEST-DELETED-IMAGES.json, and journal every unlink. D requires a complete checksum-pinned dry receipt bound to scope and source hashes. Gross reclaim counts unique allocated inodes only when all hardlinks are eligible; manifest/text-copy overhead is not deducted.
